fact: The article says Sudan has had no updated population data since its 2008 national census, the last one held.
source_slug: 2026-01-29 How to build trust alongside Sudan's digital identity system

fact: The Central Bureau of Statistics, with UNDP, issued the Sudan Multidimensional Poverty Survey 2023 report (dated June 2026), described as a nationally representative household survey covering 185 of 189 localities; the date is the report's cover date, the page being published 2026-07-26.
The report refers to 2008 as the year of the national census, whose population and household counts still underlie the survey sampling frame.
UNFPA states Sudan's last formal census was conducted in 2008 and there has been none since.
